description: Scaffold a TypeScript skeleton for an n8n custom node from a plain-English description. Returns a single TypeScript file implementing INodeType with description, credentials reference, and an execute method stub. Pure code generation — no network, no filesystem writes.

description.description: Plain-English description of what the node should do (1+ chars).

nodeName.description: Optional PascalCase class name, e.g. 'DiscordRateLimited'. Derived from the description if omitted.

name: node_scaffold

display_name.description: Human-readable display name shown in the n8n UI.

language.description: Always 'typescript' — n8n custom nodes are TS-only.

node_name.description: PascalCase class name of the generated node.

source.description: The full TypeScript source of the scaffolded node.

title: Scaffold an n8n custom node
